narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two thousand three hundred fifty two works, because it is even and passes the test for eight.
<bookmark mark='two'/>That number ends in two, so five does not divide it, and neither does ten.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Passing the test for eight is not enough, because all five tests must pass.
